customerArea.title: Your tickets
customerArea.description: Everything you've bought, from every organizer, in one place.
customerArea.linkedDescription: This is the purchase your confirmation email links to.
customerArea.reversedDescription: These tickets were released and are no longer valid for entry. Contact the organizer if you believe that is a mistake.

customerArea.nothingUpcomingDescription: Your past tickets are below, and there's always something new to find.
customerArea.emptyDescription: When you buy tickets, they'll show up here — from every organizer you buy from.
